painPoints.title: Inefficient job scheduling and dispatching
painPoints.description: Manual processes to assign jobs and notify technicians leads to delays and errors.

painPoints.title: Fragmented customer and job data
painPoints.description: Customer and job information spread across multiple systems, making it hard to access and analyze.

painPoints.title: Repetitive invoice and billing tasks
painPoints.description: Time-consuming manual processes to generate, send, and track customer invoices and payments.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate inventory management
painPoints.description: Lack of real-time visibility into stock levels leads to over/under-ordering and waste.

painPoints.title: Compliance and reporting challenges
painPoints.description: Difficulty generating required regulatory and financial reports due to data silos and manual processes.

painPoints.title: Cumbersome job tracking and updates
painPoints.description: Manual processes to record job progress, materials used, and time spent result in errors.

painPoints.title: Delayed payroll and timekeeping
painPoints.description: Inefficient systems to track employee hours and process payroll, leading to mistakes and delays.

painPoints.title: Inefficient equipment maintenance scheduling
painPoints.description: Reactive rather than proactive maintenance due to lack of usage data and automation.

painPoints.title: Siloed customer communication channels
painPoints.description: Customers reach out through various channels, making it hard to track and respond effectively.

painPoints.title: Limited visibility into business KPIs
painPoints.description: Difficulty generating and analyzing reports on key operational and financial metrics in real-time.
